title: One of the two repeats is fixed; the other is not
why: ADVERSARIAL, and the reason case 3 matters. If the twins share a lineage, fixing one reads as fixing both - a false 'resolved' on a defect still in the tree. The second half of the case is that the fix must itself be evidenced: WireA is recorded in `removed_symbols`, so the site is observably gone rather than merely unmatched. Without that record this is unresolved, and calling it `ended` would be claiming a fix from a failed search.

expect.note: the file survives, but DocView.WireA does not - the site is observably gone

structural_context is what DISCRIMINATES occ-a2 from occ-a1 - the twins agree on everything else - but it is not what licenses the mapping on its own. Listing only the discriminator let this case sit under the contract's own floor, which forbids a continued on one kind. `evidence_at_least` means what it says: the minimum that must have fired.

forbid: occ-a1 ended on the strength of no match alone - without removed_symbols this is unresolved
